description: This is a shell script for setting up and orchestrating Docker containers for the OpenClaw project. It handles configuration, building/pulling Docker images, setting permissions, and optionally setting up sandbox environments.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: require_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command exists in PATH.

methods.name: run_docker_build
methods.description: Builds a Docker image with BuildKit enabled.

methods.name: is_truthy_value
methods.description: Checks if a value is considered true (e.g., 'true', 'yes', '1').

methods.name: read_config_gateway_token
methods.description: Reads the gateway token from a JSON configuration file.

methods.name: read_env_gateway_token
methods.description: Reads the gateway token from an environment file.

methods.name: ensure_control_ui_allowed_origins
methods.description: Sets the allowed origins for the control UI if not already configured.

methods.name: sync_gateway_mode_and_bind
methods.description: Sets the gateway mode and bind configuration.

methods.name: run_prestart_gateway
methods.description: Runs a command inside a Docker container via docker compose.

methods.name: run_prestart_cli
methods.description: Runs a CLI command via docker compose, specifically for OpenClaw.

methods.name: run_runtime_cli
methods.description: Runs a runtime CLI command within the Docker compose context.

methods.name: contains_disallowed_chars
methods.description: Checks if a string contains disallowed control characters.

methods.name: is_valid_timezone
methods.description: Verifies if a timezone string matches a zone in /usr/share/zoneinfo.

methods.name: validate_mount_path_value
methods.description: Validates a mount path for disallowed characters and formatting.

methods.name: validate_named_volume
methods.description: Validates that a volume name matches expected naming conventions.

methods.name: write_extra_compose
methods.description: Generates an extra Docker Compose YAML configuration with specified volumes and mounts.

methods.name: upsert_env
methods.description: Updates or adds environment variables in a file.
